names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 1 Ιουνίου, «Άγιοι Ιούστος, Ιουστίνος, Χαρίτων, Χαρίτω η παρθένος, Ευέλπιστος, Ιέραξ, Παίων και Λιβεριανός», with the rank words and the epithet η παρθένος left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 1. јун ст. ст., „Свети мученик Јустин, Харитон, Харита, Евелпист, Јеракс, Пеон, Валеријан и Јуст“, which enumerates eight names and puts him third. The rank words stand once at the head of the company — Свети мученик, the `martyr` this corpus puts in `types` — and nothing else in the heading is strippable, so the form is the bare personal name the heading itself prints and no fuller form exists in this source to prefer.

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 1 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **The company is enumerated, so it is one folder per member**: the page prints a separate heading for each of the eight and a separate epigram for each name. Four of the eight the corpus already keeps from doxologia's 1 iunie — Justus, Justin, Chariton and Valerian — and this Charito is the first of the four it did not. **She is not Chariton.** The two names stand side by side in the one line, the page's own epigram treats them as two — «Θείος Xαρίτων και Xαριτώ παρθένος, Tμηθέντες ευμοιρούσι θείων χαρίτων» — and the calendar marks her a virgin and him not. No year is given for the company, so the folder has no `dates`; the page dates the persecution only by naming Marcus Aurelius. No hymn is printed for any of the eight.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 14.06.2026 (1. јун ст. ст.) — „Свети мученик Јустин, Харитон, Харита, Евелпист, Јеракс, Пеон, Валеријан и Јуст“

attestations.note: The day’s second entry, whose heading names him third. The heading is quoted as the Prologue prints it, without a closing full stop, as every heading of this wave is. THE COMPANY OF EIGHT, AND ALL EIGHT HAVE FOLDERS. The heading enumerates eight names and the corpus keeps every one of them, which is why this entry is eight upgrades and no new folder: four of them stand in doxologia’s own calendar lines for 1 iunie (justin-companion-of-chariton, chariton-companion-of-justin, valerian-companion-of-justin, justus-1-june) and four were written off saint.gr, which names eight where the Romanian named four (charito, euelpistus, hierax-1-june, paion). All eight were already on the menologion 1/6 day list, so the day list alone found them and no grep was needed — the first time in this wave that has happened on a company. `sr-namesweep.mjs` scores only the first name of an enumerated company, its fourth known failure mode, so it was no use here either way. THE BODY IS FOUR SENTENCES AND IT GIVES THREE THINGS NONE OF THE OTHER TWO BOOKS GIVES: the place and the reign together („Сви пострадали у Риму за време Марка Аврелија и епарха Рустика“, naming Rusticus an епарх where doxologia makes him prefect of the city); the eparch’s one question and Justin’s answer to it, „Не мислимо него знамо“ — we do not think, we know; and A YEAR, 163, which is the first year any book read for any of these eight has printed. THE YEAR IS WRITTEN AS A `death` ON ALL EIGHT, AND IT IS A FIRST DATE FOR EVERY ONE OF THEM. „После тога сви беху обезглављени, 163. године“ is stated flat, of the whole company, with no „око“ and nothing to derive it from; `basis` is `traditional`, the interval is 163 to 163, and all eight folders held `dates: null` before today. No birth, no floruit and no `locations` on any of them. `types` untouched on all eight: the heading’s Свети мученик is the `martyr` they already carry, and it is the only rank word in the heading. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day carries only the verse.

death.note: Охридски пролог for 1. јун ст. ст., of the whole enumerated company of eight: „После тога сви беху обезглављени, 163. године“. Stated flat, with no „око“ and nothing to derive it from. It is the first year any book read for this folder has printed; doxologia's life gives none and saint.gr's line gives none (5 October 2026).
